summary: Iteration 8: tested customer-collect redirect, advance-balance formula, customer income auto-category, dashboard summary, account/site filtering in transaction + hakediş forms, distribution repo parsing + GitHub build status, and light regression. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (after correcting 1 test assumption). Frontend desktop + mobile: all requested flows work. Found 1 real backend bug: the %6 overhead virman counts as a payment on the customer hakediş (paid/remaining, close_if_paid). It is also created when apply_overhead=false.

critical.issue: The %6 overhead virman transaction (type 'virman') carries progress_payment_id, so it is summed as a payment. Example: a customer hakediş with net 100,000 shows paid 6,000 / remaining 94,000 although nothing was collected. The UI 'Tahsilatlar' card shows 'Ödenen ₺6.000' and lists the virman as a tahsilat row. close_if_paid uses the same aggregation, so a hakediş with a large advance_deduction (net < 6% of subtotal) is wrongly marked 'odendi' automatically on approval. Fix: add type in ['gelir','gider'] (or type != 'virman') to the paid/pending filters in progress_payments_list and the $match in close_if_paid.

minor.issue: The overhead virman is created for müşteri hakediş even when apply_overhead=false (overhead_amount=0). Reproduced: apply_overhead false, subtotal 100,000 → overhead_amount 0 but virman 6,000 into genel_gider. The list card shows 'GG −₺0,00' while the kasa gets 6,000, which is inconsistent. Confirm the intended business rule: either skip the virman when apply_overhead is false, or always apply it.

integration_issues.issue: Shows the %6 virman as a tahsilat row and as 'Ödenen' amount (root cause is the backend issue above)

issues: Windows/Android download buttons have an href as soon as any repo is saved, even when build-status shows no .exe/.apk in the release. The user gets a GitHub 404. Consider disabling them when status.assets has no matching file.
With a repo that has many release assets, the 'Yayınlanan dosyalar' line becomes a very long wall of text. Consider truncating it or showing only .exe/.apk.

design_issues.issue_note: If an account is chosen and the user then picks a site the account is not assigned to, account_id stays set but is no longer among the options, so the select looks blank while still holding a value. Minor; consider clearing account_id when it falls out of accOptions.
issues: Hidden stale account_id selection after a site change

action_items: Exclude type 'virman' from paid/pending in progress_payments_list and from the close_if_paid aggregation (routers/progress.py)
Decide whether create_overhead_virman should respect apply_overhead=false; align the virman with h.overhead_amount
Optional: gate the /indir download buttons on status assets containing .exe/.apk
critical_code_review_comments: progress.py PayForm in ProgressDetail.jsx still contains müşteri wording/branches that are now unreachable (dead code). Harmless.
create_transaction auto-category: when the balance is exactly 0, it becomes 'Avans'. This matches the spec (balance > 0 means Hakediş Tahsilatı).
outstanding_advance sums all approved gelir/gider of the account, including 'Diğer' category. This is consistent with the spec formula.

success_rate.backend: 90% (10/10 tests pass; 1 bug found via UI/API inspection)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_ data (accounts, sites, hakedişler, transactions) was created and then deleted. github_repo was restored to ''. Verified 0 TEST_ records remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_customer_collect.py (it cleans up after itself). UI seed: python /app/backend/tests/ui_seed_iter8.py seed|clean. Retest: customer hakediş /payments should report paid 0 after approval (virman excluded). Verified OK: müşteri /pay returns 400 with 'İşlemler'; taşeron /pay returns 201; the advance-balance scenario 3M → 0 → 0 → 1M with balance -1M; auto-category; dashboard summary (5 quick tiles link correctly); site→account and account→site filtering in TransactionForm and the hakediş form; /indir build-status with electron/electron; mobile 390px has no overflow.
rca of the issue: Root cause: create_overhead_virman stores progress_payment_id on the virman transaction (needed for removal and delete-guard). progress_payments_list and close_if_paid query transactions by progress_payment_id without a type filter. Mitigation: filter type in ('gelir','gider') in both queries.
